name: Double Ditto
summary: Party game where players write two answers to a category and score for matching others.
rules_text: Players get score sheets. The deck of 400 category cards is shuffled. In rotation a Ditto Master draws and reads a category, e.g. 'Types of cheeses', and starts a 15-second timer. All players, including the Master, secretly write two answers. Then in clockwise order starting with the Master, each player reads their two answers. Any other player who wrote the same answer says Ditto and both players cross that answer off. No points for unmatched answers. Scoring per round: one crossed = 1 point, both crossed = 3 points for Double Ditto. Players track own total. The next player becomes Ditto Master. Game ends after each player has been Master 4 times with 4-6 players, 3 times with 7-9 players, or 1-2 times with 10+ players. Highest total wins.
rating_reason: Simultaneous answer matching, opponent modeling, arithmetic scoring
